subject_uz: Bank mijozlari uchun 500 dona HUMO to'lov terminallari (POS) xarid qilish

requirements.summary_en: 500 payment terminals: Android-based, 4G and Wi-Fi, chip/NFC/magstripe reader, 6-inch display, built-in printer.

requirements.summary_en: The supplier must hold the HUMO national interbank processing centre's licence for software connection and programming.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisidan avtorizatsiyaga ega bo'lishi lozim.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must hold authorisation from the device manufacturer.
requirements.quote: Imkon bo'lsa, tavsiya xatlari ham taqdim etilishi mumkin.) Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisidan avtorizatsiyaga

requirements.summary_uz: Servis markazlari soni bo'yicha ball: 1-5 hududda 5 ball, 6-10 hududda 10 ball, barcha hududlarda 15 ball.
requirements.summary_en: Points for regional service centres: 1-5 regions 5 points, 6-10 regions 10 points, all regions 15 points.
requirements.quote: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi hududlarida servis markazlari mavjudligi

requirements.summary_en: 10 technical points depend on bank statements of turnover and debt status.
requirements.quote: Faoliyat yurituvchi bankdan ma’lumot: 1. Asosiy hisobvaraqlar harakatda ekanligi

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik bahoning 10 balli ishtirokchining sotuvlar tajribasi to'g'risidagi ma'lumotga bog'langan.
requirements.summary_en: 10 technical points depend on information about the bidder's past sales in this line.
requirements.quote: Ishtirokchi ushbu yo‘nalishdagi sotuvlarni amalga oshirganligi to‘g‘risida

requirements.summary_uz: 10 ball HUMO protsessing markazi bilan dasturiy ta'minotga ulanish bo'yicha o'zaro kelishuv mavjudligiga beriladi.
requirements.summary_en: 10 points relate to having an agreement with the HUMO processing centre on software connection.
requirements.quote: to‘lov terminallarining dasturiy taʼminotiga bogʻlanish, dasturlash boʻyicha o‘zaro kelishuvi boʻlishi kerak

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi taklif qilinayotgan qurilmalarning talablarga muvofiqligini ko'rsatuvchi texnik va foydalanish hujjatlarini taqdim etishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must supply technical and user documents allowing conformity of the offered devices to be checked.
requirements.quote: texnik va foydalanish hujjatlarini taqdim etishi

flags.quote: Imkon bo'lsa, tavsiya xatlari ham taqdim etilishi mumkin.) Ishtirokchi qurilma ishlab chiqaruvchisidan avtorizatsiyaga
flags.explanation_uz: Ishlab chiqaruvchidan avtorizatsiya talab qilinmoqda, shu bilan birga texnik topshiriq o'xshash yoki ustun jihozlarni ham qabul qilishini aytadi. Avtorizatsiya xati faqat bir necha yirik distribyutorda bo'lishi mumkin va shu sababli 500 dona terminalni yetkaza oladigan boshqa yetkazib beruvchilar ishtirok eta olmasligi mumkin. Boshlang'ich narx 1 295 000 000 so'm.
flags.explanation_en: Authorisation from the manufacturer is required, while the specification also says similar or better devices are accepted. Such a letter may be held by only a few large distributors, so other suppliers able to deliver 500 terminals may be unable to bid. The lot's start price is 1,295,000,000 UZS.
flags.rewrite_uz: Ishtirokchi taklif etilayotgan qurilmalarning qonuniy manbadan kelganini (ishlab chiqaruvchi, uning rasmiy distribyutori yoki boshqa tasdiqlovchi hujjat orqali) va ularga kafolat berishi mumkinligini tasdiqlashi lozim.
flags.rewrite_en: The bidder must show that the offered devices come from a lawful source (the manufacturer, its official distributor or another supporting document) and that the bidder can honour the warranty.

flags.quote: Ishtirokchi korxonasining direktor va ta’sischisining passport nusxasi yoki ID card
flags.explanation_uz: Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat mezoni (10 ball) direktor va ta'sischining pasport nusxasi bilan baholanadi, bu esa mahsulot yoki xizmatga aloqador emas. Shu bilan birga 1-mezon (10 ball) bank aylanmasi ma'lumotiga va 2-mezon (10 ball) yillik balansga bog'langan: jami 30 ball texnik jihatga emas, umumiy hujjatlarga bog'liq. Bu shablon matnga o'xshaydi.
flags.explanation_en: The post-warranty service criterion (10 points) is scored on a copy of the director's and founder's passport, which has no link to the product or service. The 1st criterion (10 points, bank turnover statements) and the 2nd (10 points, annual balance sheet) are similar: 30 points in total depend on general documents rather than on the offer. This looks like standard template wording.
flags.rewrite_uz: Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat mezoni bo'yicha ballar kafolat muddati, xizmat ko'rsatish joyi va javob berish vaqti kabi ko'rsatkichlar bo'yicha berilsin; shaxsiy hujjatlar baholanmasin.
flags.rewrite_en: Score the post-warranty service criterion on warranty period, service location and response time; do not score personal identity documents.

flags.quote: O‘zbekiston Respublikasi hududlarida servis markazlari mavjudligi
flags.explanation_uz: Servis markazlari bo'lgan hududlar soniga qarab 5, 10 yoki 15 ball beriladi: barcha hududda markazi bor ishtirokchi, 1-5 hududda markazi bor ishtirokchidan 10 ball ortiq oladi. Bu 1-2 hududda xizmat ko'rsatishga qodir kichik yetkazib beruvchilarga ta'sir qiladi. Texnik baho 70 foiz.
flags.explanation_en: Points of 5, 10 or 15 are awarded by number of regions with service centres, so a bidder covering all regions gets up to 10 points more than one covering 1-5 regions. This disadvantages smaller suppliers who could service the devices through a partner. Technical score weighs 70 percent.
flags.rewrite_uz: Servis xizmati hududlar bo'yicha o'z markazi yoki shartnoma asosidagi hamkor orqali ta'minlanishi mumkin; ball javob berish muddati va ehtiyot qismlar mavjudligi bo'yicha berilsin.
flags.rewrite_en: Allow regional service to be provided through own centres or contracted partners, and score response time and spare-part availability instead of centre count.
